notes.title: Axial Disc 2 Available Now!
notes.content:
Before beginning Axial Disc 2, it's recommended you transfer a save file from Axial Disc 1! Here's what we recommend!

1. Beat the game. You can only transfer save files that have completed the main story in Axial Disc 1.

2. Collect every summon. Summons are very powerful types of skills that will give you an edge in Axial Disc 2's later content!

3. Power up your party. Make sure your whole party is at the level you want them to be before you transfer! You'll be able to level up and use stat boosting coffee eventually in Disc 2, but getting ahead of the curve will save you time in the long run!

4. Collect Eater Eyes. Eater Eyes will be carried over and can be used on Disc 2's new party members alongside Amara after she returns! Stock up a lot of Eater Eyes for an advantage early on!


Enjoy the grand finale in Axial Disc 2!
